info.name: Stockline Orders
info.description: One collection for the Stockline Orders course. Open the module, then the current lesson folder. Run only that lesson folder against its matching code checkpoint; lesson expectations differ.

item.name: Lesson 01 - Isolate the Payment Provider

item.description: Development only. Run the approval sequence first. Decline and lost-reply folders require a manual simulator environment change and API restart; do not run all scenario folders as one collection run. No real provider, retry or durable recording.

item.name: Read the last order in this API process

exec: pm.test("Order state and captured price are unchanged", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(63.75); pm.expect(order.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03OrderStatus")); });

request.description: Read before restarting or making enough requests to evict this entry. The sink is process-local, capacity 100, oldest-first; it is not a financial audit.

exec: pm.test("One returned application attempt, original decision", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(rows[0].operationKey).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03OperationKey")); pm.expect(rows[0].amount).to.eql(63.75); pm.expect(rows[0].termination).to.eql("Returned"); pm.expect(rows[0].decision).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03Decision")); pm.expect(rows[0].exceptionType).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Lesson 02 - One Order Two Local Reactions
item.description: Run one scenario folder at a time after configuring and restarting the API. Approve/SUCCESS remains the in-process provider. Receipt failure demo: Development only, OrderPreviews__FailReceipt=true. No email/shipment, retry, durable bus or exactly-once claim. Use the same requests against the supplied direct-call comparison and completed observer code.

item.name: 01 - Confirmed - two previews - Approve and FailReceipt=false

exec: pm.test("Original checkout outcome survives previews", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().total).to.eql(63.75); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("Confirmed"); });
const order = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("m03OrderId", order.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("m03OperationKey", order.operationKey);

pm.test("Authoritative state is independent of previews", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03OrderStatus")); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(63.75); });

item.name: Read local receipt and fulfillment previews

exec: pm.test("One confirmed order produces local previews or visible partial failure", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const view = pm.response.json(); const id = pm.collectionVariables.get("m03OrderId"); pm.expect(view.orderId).to.eql(id); pm.expect(view.fulfillment).to.eql({orderId:id, sku:"CAB-105", quantity:10}); if (pm.collectionVariables.get("m03ReceiptFailure") === "true") { pm.expect(view.receipt).to.eql(null); pm.expect(view.failedReactions).to.eql(["ReceiptPreviewReaction"]); } else { pm.expect(view.receipt).to.eql({orderId:id, total:63.75, currency:"USD"}); pm.expect(view.failedReactions).to.eql([]); } });

item.name: Payment remains one application attempt for 63.75

exec: pm.test("Preview processing does not authorize again", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const attempts = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(attempts.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(attempts[0].amount).to.eql(63.75); pm.expect(attempts[0].decision).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03Decision")); });

pm.test("Original checkout outcome survives previews", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().total).to.eql(63.75); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("Declined"); });
const order = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("m03OrderId", order.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("m03OperationKey", order.operationKey);

pm.test("Authoritative state is independent of previews", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.status).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("m03OrderStatus")); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(63.75); });
pm.test("Declined or indeterminate orders cause no confirmed-order reaction", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
